notes: Observatory restart: watch 300 autonomous residents from outside the city. Search, inspect, pin, compare and follow lives; open buildings and select occupants; read finances, relationships, learned choices and event histories. Five central corporations offer 280 jobs with weekly hiring and four 12-hour weekdays. There are 200 competitive part-time shifts including 10 casino shifts; corporate workers have a one-shift cap and unemployed residents can win several. Different rents and job grades, a $25,000 weekly money injection cap, and individual online-trained neural networks shape the simulation. Old citizen names and balances migrate with a backup; the city and routines restart. Passed 30/300-resident runtime simulations, save/reload tests, six manually reviewed visual checkpoints, and signed Android export. Same app identity, signing certificate and Update button. This is a compact observer foundation with abstract interiors and a pooled business treasury, not a detailed human-behavior model.
